scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,client "npm run start --prefix api" "npm run start --prefix client"
scripts.start:prod: npm run install:all && npm run prisma:generate --prefix api && npm run start
